findings.text: In `LocalFlags`, `addToLocal` skips any flag whose name appears in `parentsPflags`. A child's own local flag that shadows a parent's persistent flag (child defines `--verbose`, parent has a persistent `--verbose`) is therefore dropped from `LocalFlags()`. The usual check compares the flag pointer, not just the name. As a result `LocalFlags`, `LocalNonPersistentFlags` and the help output omit a flag the command really defines.

The new `mergePersistentFlags` and `LocalFlags` no longer fold `flag.CommandLine` into the root command's persistent flags. The old code did this when `!x.HasParent()`. Flags registered on the global pflag `CommandLine`, for example through `AddGoFlagSet`, are no longer recognised. Passing one on the command line now fails with 'unknown flag', and it no longer shows in help.

1.reason: The patch deletes both `flag.CommandLine.VisitAll` merges (from the old `mergePersistentFlags` and `LocalFlags`), and neither the new `updateParentsPersistentFlags` nor the new `mergePersistentFlags` adds the global `CommandLine` flags to the root. As a result, globally registered flags are no longer parsed or shown in help; this is a separate defect from the shadowed-local-flag reference bug.
